subject: POC readiness — stewardship commitments & pilot timing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com>, Aaron Duval <aaron.duval@fathomlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: POC readiness — stewardship commitments & pilot timing

Hi Lena / Aaron —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the MAP is formalized. I tried to capture ownership lines you asked for during the call. Please correct anything that I’ve assigned incorrectly.

High-level goal for the POC
- Validate RB-inference integration with Fathom’s ingestion pipeline at 10k tokens/minute sustained for a 2-week window, with 95th percentile latency < 250ms for single-turn generation.

Success criteria (customer-facing)
- Functionality: model responses match your existing acceptance prompts (we’ll run your 30 canonical prompts).
- Performance: stable throughput at target QPS and <250ms p95.
- Security/compliance: no unapproved egress; audit logging available for all requests.

Initial Owner matrix (Redwood / Fathom) — please confirm
- Infra (where the runtime will run / VPC peering / network): Redwood owner: Marcus Lin; Fathom owner: Aaron Duval (platform).
- App integration (SDK, request shaping, prompt templates): Redwood owner: Monica Patel; Fathom owner: Lena Ortiz (product).
- Security & checklist (SOC2 items, data retention): Redwood owner: Naomi Feldman; Fathom owner: security@fathomlabs.com.
- Procurement / contract / billing: Redwood owner: Ben Carter; Fathom owner: procurement@fathomlabs.com.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): exchange MAP and security checklist (I attached a template to this thread).
- Week 1: network connectivity + smoke test (small traffic).
- Weeks 2–3: scale run and acceptance prompts.
- Week 4: decision window and next steps (production plan or extended pilot).

Attachments: Mutual-Action-Plan-template.xlsx (attached) — please drop your version with dates and Fathom owners. Also, if you can attach the security checklist you referenced, we’ll map gaps.

Next steps (short):
1) Lena: please confirm Fathom owners and add expected procurement lead + timeline (we need PO/contract cadence to schedule Dedicated capacity).
2) Aaron: confirm infra details (VPC CIDR, egress restrictions) and whether you’ll need on-prem option or VPC peering.
3) Marcus/Monica/Ben: I’ll follow up internally to confirm Redwood timelines/capacity.

I’m looping in Marcus/Monica/Ben to own the Redwood side comms. If that looks good I’ll create the MAP in Drive and we can iterate.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Mutual-Action-Plan-template.xlsx
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC readiness — stewardship commitments & pilot timing

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming high level and adding Fathom-side owners: 

- Infra (VPC/peering): Aaron Duval (aaron.duval@fathomlabs.com) — we will own the platform side and can open peering the week of 11/30.
- App integration: Lena Ortiz (product) — I’ll coordinate SDK hooks with Monica.
- Security: I’m copying our security team (security@fathomlabs.com) — attached is the Fathom-Security-Checklist you requested. There are a couple of items around retention we’ll want to confirm with legal.
- Procurement: procurement@fathomlabs.com — procurement lead will be on the thread separately. Expected PO turnaround: ~3 weeks after contract.

Timeline notes: peering week of 11/30 sounds good. We can do smoke tests 12/1–12/3 and move into scaled runs 12/6–12/17. Decision window target: 12/20.

I’ve attached our security checklist. We’ll open a shared MAP in Drive after we get your filled template.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product
Fathom Labs
lena.ortiz@fathomlabs.com

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC readiness — stewardship commitments & pilot timing

Folks — following up to confirm Redwood commitments against Fathom’s owners and the proposed timeline. 

Decisions / Redwood owners (confirmed)
- Network & peering setup: Marcus Lin — lead for Redwood on VPC peering, security groups, and perf baseline measurements. Deliverable: peering validation checklist (due 2026-11-30).
- Integration & SDK work: Monica Patel — will produce sample request/response templates and integration guide. Deliverable: integration guide and test harness (due 2026-12-01).
- Commercial & contract: Ben Carter — will drive SOW and contract terms and coordinate procurement timeline. Deliverable: initial SOW + redline window (due 2026-12-03).
- Naomi (me) will hold security checklist mapping and escalation conduit for any policy gaps.

Operation notes:
- Marcus: please confirm whether Fathom needs a dedicated pool or whether we start on hosted with pinned capacity (they’ll need guidance by 11/30 so procurement can align).
- Monica: sync with Lena on SDK hooks; we should exchange a small test corpus (5–10 prompts) by 11/29 to verify parity.
- Ben: estimate of contract lead time matches their 3-week PO turnaround — flag anything that would shorten this window.

I’ve uploaded the populated MAP to the Drive link below (small edits only) and attached our MAP template in the first message. If everyone agrees I’ll schedule the peering kickoff for 2026-11-30 16:00 PT (30 min).

Best,
Naomi
